title: Glowing spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5f7e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c62f5a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8791c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- motion swirls -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='38' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#7ee8ff' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.75' stroke-dasharray='14 12'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='28' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#b3f7ff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6' stroke-dasharray='9 11'/>

  <!-- stem / handle -->
  <rect x='47' y='12' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='#fff3a8'/>

  <!-- top body: wide cap -->
  <path d='M22 38 Q50 12 78 38 L72 44 Q50 30 28 44 Z' fill='url(#bodyTop)'/>
  <path d='M28 44 Q50 30 72 44 L70 50 Q50 38 30 50 Z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>

  <!-- stripe band -->
  <rect x='26' y='50' width='48' height='6' fill='#7ee8ff' rx='2'/>

  <!-- lower cone -->
  <path d='M30 56 Q50 62 70 56 L53 82 L47 82 Z' fill='url(#bodyBot)'/>

  <!-- spin highlight on cone -->
  <path d='M36 58 L48 78 L44 78 Z' fill='#ffd59e' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- tip -->
  <path d='M47 82 Q50 92 53 82 Z' fill='#c7f9ff'/>

  <!-- shine dots on cap -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#fff0f4' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='2.2' fill='#fff0f4' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
